consolidation.headline: Northwind Retail signs a three-year managed service contract

facts: Priya Shah and Tom Evans signed Northwind Retail to a three-year managed service contract on 22 September.
Onboarding for Northwind Retail starts in October.
Northwind's annual contract value is about 180 thousand pounds.
The Contoso migration went live on 20 September.
The Contoso migration went live two days early.
The Contoso team finished user training on 24 September.
Lucy Grey joins the service desk on 29 September.
Sam Patel covered the service desk over the bank holiday weekend.
Litware Supplies will raise the price of its business laptops by 5 per cent from 1 November 2026.
Litware Supplies orders placed before 31 October 2026 keep the current price.
Dan Wood celebrates their birthday on 2 October.
Tom Evans's baby Ava was born on 25 September.
